name: endroit/workplace
description: Human operational gestures for entering, using and advancing work in a Home.

capabilities.description: Enter the Home or one Room from authoritative sources.
Call the concrete researcher occupant through provider-hosted delegation.
Work through the concrete engineer role for the current Meeting.
Use the first-party research method without transferring ownership to the Skill.
Retain, accept, deliver or archive the current bounded result explicitly.
Work on or deliver to one declared Site through a revalidated Route.

skills.description: Enter this Home and reload its authoritative sources.
Enter one resolved Room and reload its authoritative sources.
Work on one declared Site through a revalidated Route.
Call the concrete researcher occupant when the provider supports delegation.
Work as the concrete engineer role for this Meeting.
Use the first-party research method in the current place.
Retain the current result as inspectable Material.
Accept the current result as owner-authorized truth.
Deliver the current result to its explicit destination.
Deliver the current result to one declared Site.
Archive inactive retained or accepted Material explicitly.
